title: Max Miller Seeks Ethics Probe Into Himself Over Abuse Claims
title_cn: 马克斯·米勒就虐待指控寻求对自己进行道德调查
summary: Embattled Ohio Representative Max Miller said he’s seeking an ethics investigation “to clear my name” after facing calls to resign from Congress amid accusations of domestic abuse.

title: Big Oil’s Profits Are in Democrats’ Sights If House Flips
title_cn: 如果众议院发生翻转，大型石油公司的利润将进入民主党的视线
summary: Democrats plan to scrutinize soaring profits in the oil sector if they take control of the House of Representatives in the midterm elections, raising the specter that companies could face congressional investigations and hearings.

title: API CEO Says Higher Oil Prices Will Spur Production Investments
title_cn: API首席执行官表示油价上涨将刺激生产投资
summary: American Petroleum Institute President and CEO Mike Sommers says higher energy prices now mean investments in future production. Speaking on "Balance of Power," Sommers also says the US should be building more refineries and permitting reform should be a priority for lawmakers. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Cuba Emerges From Blackout, Blaming ‘Genocidal’ US Sanctions
title_cn: 古巴摆脱停电，指责美国的“种族灭绝”制裁
summary: Cuba restored electricity across the island nearly 36 hours after it suffered yet another national blackout.
